signals.usability_note: Clear view of a two-story colonial-style house with a long driveway, partially obscured by a large Japanese maple and trees on the right.

yard_sign.detail: A metal sign post near the curb is seen edge-on; its face is not visible and it appears to be a street/traffic sign rather than a yard sign.
